priorityList: Keep Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word active by using Vampiric Touch to apply both DoTs
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word if it is not active, about to expire, or you are about to cap out on Insanity
Cast Void Blast while available if Shadow Word is active or Entropic Rift is about to expire
Cast Void Torrent to open up Entropic Rift
